{{Quote|What's the situation, Captain?|General Grievous, to Captain Lushros Dofine during the Battle of Coruscant|audio=WhatsTheSituation-ROTS.flac|<ref name="rots" />}}
'''Lushros Dofine''' was the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|''Providence''-class carrier/destroyer]] [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Born to the [[Dofine family|Dofines]] of [[Neimoidia/Legends|Neimoidia]], he exhibited a cool demeanor not usually associated with his fellow Neimoidians, and so he rose through the ranks of his society with relative ease. He trained as a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] captain in the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], and in time, he was given command of a [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class battleship]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], he was present at the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], and he aided [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] in retreating from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] onslaught.

Dofine's actions at [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] earned him the respect of Grievous, who put him in command of the ''Invisible Hand''. Dofine saw much combat during the Clone Wars, and the calmness he had exuded throughout his life served him well once again. The Neimoidian fought his last [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|battle]] at the Republic's capital world, [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. After Grievous had successfully kidnapped [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], Dofine began his retreat, but he was harried by both [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] that had boarded the ship, and Republic [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] that were engaging in broadsides with him. As the situation continued to sour, Dofine abandoned ship, but his [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] was struck by stray [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] fire in the process, [[Death/Legends|killing]] the captain instantly.

==Biography==
===Early career===
Born to the [[Dofine family]] of [[Neimoidia/Legends|Neimoidia]], Lushros Dofine hailed from a long lineage of successful and influential conservative negotiators within the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. The uncanny ability of the Dofines to know just when to retreat at the negotiation table had saved the Federation billions over the [[Standard year/Legends|years]], so their standing with the conglomerate at the [[Time/Legends|time]] of Lushros' birth was considerable. When he came of age, Dofine himself joined the Federation, and, following in the footsteps of his cousin [[Daultay Dofine/Legends|Daultay Dofine]], trained as a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]]. Despite the fact that he was preceded by his cousin, Dofine would constantly insist that he achieved his goals by his own volition. His calm demeanor helped him rise through the ranks of his society, although he earned the ire of some of his fellow Neimoidians in the process.<ref name="db" />

===The Clone Wars===
By [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Dofine was [[Captain/Legends|captaining]] a [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class battleship]], which was present at [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] when the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|invaded]], starting the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[Core ship/Legends|core]] of Dofine's ship was on the Geonosian surface at the time, and was one of the last of its kind to leave the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. One of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]' [[General/Legends|generals]], [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], was also late in evacuating, and so he left the planet on Dofine's ship. The Republic dispatched [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighters]] after the fleeing Confederate craft, but Dofine was more than able to hold them off, buying his compatriots more time to escape.<ref name="db" />

Grievous was impressed with the way that Dofine had acquitted himself in the final hours of the battle, and when he took the [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|''Providence''-class carrier/destroyer]] [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']] as his flagship, he selected Dofine as the ship's captain. As the Clone Wars raged across the galaxy, Dofine saw combat in many engagements, but his calmness in the face of Grievous' intimidating personality allowed him to gain the respect of the [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] general.<ref name="db" />

===Battle of Coruscant and death===
{{Quote|All batteries, fire! Fire!|Lushros Dofine|audio=AllBatteriesFire-ROTS.flac|<ref name="rots" />}}
[[File:LushrosDofineFire-ROTS.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Dofine on the bridge of the ''Invisible Hand''.]]
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Grievous launched a [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|surprise attack]] against the Republic's capital world of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. When Grievous himself left the ''Invisible Hand'' to kidnap [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] from the planet surface, Dofine was left in command of the fleet as it engaged the forces of the Republic.<ref name="db" /> Also aboard the ship was the leader of the Confederacy, [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. Grievous returned, his mission a success, but as the ''Invisible Hand'' prepared to leave Coruscant with the captive Chancellor, it was boarded by two [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]]: [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].<ref name="rotsn">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref> Dofine had already begun tracking their progress through the ship by the time that Grievous had reached the bridge.<ref name="rots" />

The ''Invisible Hand'' soon had more dire problems to deal with, as the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Guarlara (Venator-class)/Legends|''Guarlara'']] was moving into attack position. Dofine engaged in broadsides with the enemy ship, but the resulting battery fire from the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] damaged the ''Invisible Hand'' so severely that it began to plummet towards Coruscant's surface. The move took its toll on the ship's artificial [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]], prompting Dofine to order his [[OOM pilot battle droid/Legends|OOM pilot battle droids]] to magnetize, lest they fall to the front of the bridge. The pilots were able to right the ship eventually, at the behest of Grievous, and they were able to turn their attention back towards the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], who had succeeded in freeing Palpatine and killing Dooku. As they ventured through the ship's corridors in the hope of escaping, Dofine trapped them with [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shields]], and Grievous had them brought to the bridge.<ref name="rots" />

[[File:TheBridgeCrewEscapes.png|thumb|right|270px|Dofine flees the bridge.]]
Grievous' choice proved damaging: once on the bridge, the two Jedi were able to break free of their restraints and wreak havoc.<ref name="rots" /> Dofine, less than pleased with the situation, fled the bridge in panic, along with the rest of the crew, and boarded and then launched an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] before the general remotely launched the rest of them. The ''Invisible Hand'' was left to resume its fall towards Coruscant's surface, and while several of his colleagues, including the general and some [[OOM pilot battle droid/Legends|OOM pilot battle droids]], were picked up by other Confederate ships, Dofine's escape pod was struck by a stray [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] blast, killing the captain instantly.<ref name="db" /><ref name="rots" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Magnetize, magnetize.|Lushros Dofine|<ref name="rots" />}}
Cool, calm, and collected, the unflappable Lushros Dofine was served well by his demeanor while serving both the Trade Federation and the Confederacy of Independent Systems. Although he did not make many friends among his fellow Neimoidians, Dofine's level-headed approach to crises made him, in the eyes of some, fearsome. Although the Dofine family already had a significant standing within the Federation, and his own cousin, Daultay, had already served as a captain, Dofine was quick to mention that his path was his alone. As a tactician, he was skilled enough to gain the respect of General Grievous, making him one of the few Neimoidians to do so, although he was unable to turn the tide at the Battle of Coruscant.<ref name="db" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|This was a reuse of the Daultay Dofine mask, which prompted the naming of this guy Lushros Dofine. Ben Burtt voiced him.|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|<ref name="Pablo Tweet">{{Twitter|pabl0hidalgo|status/1521293560909230080|Pablo Hidalgo|quote=This was a reuse of the Daultay Dofine mask, which prompted the naming of this guy Lushros Dofine. Ben Burtt voiced him.}}</ref>}}
Lushros Dofine first appeared as an unnamed character in the opening scenes of [[George Lucas]]' [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']]. In the film he was portrayed by [[Colin Ware]] and voiced by [[Ben Burtt]]. The character was later identified in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (original)|Databank]]. In [[2007]], [[James Lord]] elaborated on Dofine's story through the StarWars.com [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] feature, "[[What's The Story?]]"
